frames.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE square animation frame W1, Colin the mallard walking cheerfully to the RIGHT in calm children's-book flat raster style. Reference 1 Colin canonical identity: emerald round head with three short tuft feathers, yellow bill and yellow webbed feet, lavender neckerchief with white collar, leafy green open vest, brown lower torso, grey-beige wings, restrained black outline. Reference 2 Miffy W1 specifies strong walking contact stride, upright blue watering can in bent front carrying wing (spout right, NO water), framing. Reference 3 Colin watering sheet specifies EXACT apparent scale and palette: body centre at x=285/627 and foot ground baseline y=571/627; emerald head diameter about 245/627; from tuft top about y=80/627 to ground y=570/627. Face RIGHT IN PROFILE: single visible eye, bill extending right, small brown duck tail projecting behind to left. Right near foot reaches far FORWARD right, heel on ground; left far foot far BEHIND left, toes grounded. Wide confident separation about 170/627 pixels between feet, duck-sized broad webbed feet, no shoes. Free rear wing swings BACK left opposite forward leg, can wing stays bent. Keep whole body vertical, no head tilt, can upright at lower torso about y=420, spout extending right to x=490. Background uniform flat chroma green #00ff00, with no gradient/shadow/ground line/texture. Distinguish dark emerald head and muted leafy vest from saturated lime chroma. Full uncropped figure with generous margins. No flowers, pots, scenery, droplets, text, border or duplicate frames. ONLY one W1 frame, NOT a sheet.
